user.title: Choose whole-home meter
user.description: Select the HA power sensor that represents total whole-home consumption. If saved EnergyIQ data is detected, keep Restore existing EnergyIQ data enabled to recover it, or turn it off to start fresh. Commissioning is available later from Configure.

configuration_menu.title: EnergyIQ Configuration
configuration_menu.description: Choose a configuration area. Settings are grouped so each area can expand independently as the configuration framework grows.

general.title: General
general.description: Currency, time zone, and other general EnergyIQ settings.

consumption_limits.title: Consumption Limits
consumption_limits.description: Set the consumption thresholds used by EnergyIQ.

cost_limits.title: Cost Limits
cost_limits.description: Set the cost thresholds used by EnergyIQ.

peak_time_window.title: Peak Time Window
peak_time_window.description: Define when Peak rates and Peak consumption settings apply.

utility_search.title: Utility Search
utility_search.description: Find utility rates by ZIP code, or enter utility rate information manually.

consumption_thresholds.title: Consumption setpoints
consumption_thresholds.description: Set four daily Peak and Off-Peak consumption points. Each point defines the hourly kWh boundary from green to yellow and from yellow to red. The chart compares consumption against these limits; it is not a cost chart.

data_description.peak_1_yellow: Consumption at or below this hourly amount is green.
data_description.peak_1_red: Consumption above this hourly amount is red; values between the two limits are yellow.
data_description.peak_2_yellow: Consumption at or below this hourly amount is green.
data_description.peak_2_red: Consumption above this hourly amount is red; values between the two limits are yellow.

data_description.peak_4_red: Consumption above this hourly amount is red; values between the two limits are yellow.
data_description.off_peak_1_yellow: Consumption at or below this hourly amount is green.
data_description.off_peak_1_red: Consumption above this hourly amount is red; values between the two limits are yellow.
data_description.off_peak_2_yellow: Consumption at or below this hourly amount is green.

data_description.off_peak_3_yellow: Consumption at or below this hourly amount is green.

training_prepare.title: Train {device}

training_active.title: Training active
training_active.description: Training is active for {device} ({category}). Operate the device now. For a short test, turn it on and off as instructed. For a full-cycle appliance, run the complete cycle. The training state is retained while Configure is closed. When finished, check Finish.

training_review.title: Review — {device}

training_start.title: Ready to start — {device}
training_start.description:
{instructions}

This is the point where active monitoring begins. Nothing is captured until you press START.

training_monitoring.title: Training active — {device}
training_monitoring.description:
{instruction}

Training remains stored while Configure is closed. When the training activity is complete, return here and finish the capture.

consumption_settings.title: Consumption setpoints
consumption_settings.description: Set the Peak period and the two hourly consumption limits used by the chart.

peak_period.name: Peak period
peak_period.description: Set when Peak applies. All other times are Off-Peak.

consumption_limits.name: Consumption limits
consumption_limits.description: These two limits apply to both Peak and Off-Peak.

data_description.green_yellow: At or below this amount is green.
data_description.yellow_red: Above this amount is red; values between the two limits are yellow.
